title: Lunum-Sem 1.0
description: Frozen 1.0 release of the Lunum semantic representation schema. This schema is immutable; future changes require a new version number.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Must be 'lunum-sem/0.1-draft' for backward compatibility with existing data, or 'lunum-sem/1.0' for new data.

world.description: The world in which the semantic content holds (e.g. 'real', 'hypothetical', 'counterfactual').

kind.description: The semantic kind of the content (e.g. 'simple_fact', 'obligation', 'preference', 'belief_state', 'safety_constraint', 'tool_event', 'plan_instruction').

clauses.description: One or more semantic clauses forming the content. Order is significant for multi-clause content.

references.description: External references associated with this semantic content.

annotations.description: Freeform annotations for confidence, tags, notes.

value.description: The term's value, type depends on the term type.

language.description: Language tag (BCP 47) when the term carries natural language.

ref.description: Cross-reference to another term or entity.

term.description: A semantic term: a primitive (string, number, boolean, null), a term object, or an array of terms.

clause.description: A single semantic clause with a predicate, role bindings, and optional modifiers.

roles.description: Named role bindings mapping role names to terms (e.g. agent, theme, recipient, instrument).

conditions.description: Preconditions that must hold for this clause to apply.

consequences.description: Consequences that follow from this clause.
